summary: Bifrost no longer uses RabbitMQ: every run, summary and package change is claimed from PostgreSQL. Existing Compose files and manifests keep working; the leftover rabbitmq service, its volume and any KEDA objects can be removed as the upgrade notes describe. An executor short on memory now leaves new work to others, and the API starts a worker for it on Kubernetes.

evidence: Claude drafted this summary on 2026-10-23 under Jack's standing authority for the #769 rollout (merge each stage once its gate passes). No customer action is required for an unchanged install; removing the leftover broker is optional cleanup.
